# Electron

[![Build Status](https://github.com/electron/electron/workflows/CI/badge.svg)](https://github.com/electron/electron/actions)
[![Coverage Status](https://coveralls.io/repos/github/electron/electron/badge.svg?branch=main)](https://coveralls.io/github/electron/electron?branch=main)

Build cross-platform desktop apps with JavaScript, HTML, and CSS.

[![Electron Logo](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/electron/electron/main/docs/images/electron-logo.png)](https://www.electronjs.org/)

## Features

- Chromium for rendering UI
- Node.js for backend file access
- Native OS menu and notifications

For more details, see the [official website][website] or visit our [documentation][docs].

[website]: https://www.electronjs.org
[docs]: https://www.electronjs.org/docs/latest
